title: Conditional κ = 0.001661202643272239: eight B-frame coalescences after SW4
body:
Eight B-gate frame changes improve the independently replayed PR699 witness from **κ = 0.001660666354374641** to **κ = 0.001661202643272239**. Each frame grows from dimension four to six, coalescing paid jumps. Every scalar gate, entrance, terminal frame, residual width and physical owner placement remains unchanged.

The combined local-profile change is `{1:+8, 2:-8, 3:-8, 4:+8}`. The new global profile is `{1:184033, 2:24048, 3:30961, 4:13968, 5:4032, 8:576, 44:1, 48:2396}`. The exact complex lower endpoint is `1663966829367501881629/10^24`; PR589's bit endpoint remains `1733427039589844234749/10^24`.

The standalone standard-library package rebuilds PR558, gauge44, the no-triangle and p6n words, four promotions, PR699's four read exchanges and the eight new frames. It reconstructs all 36,288 owner roles from the integer flow/matching certificate and a checked helper permutation. All inherited global-admission assertions remain identical to PR699's.

```bash
bash research/complex-sw4-frame8/verify.sh /tmp/sw4-frame8-fresh
```

Validation is recorded in `research/complex-sw4-frame8-validation/`: fresh macOS and Linux runs, exact native and independent scalar checks on all 728 columns, 2,953 phase edges, residual wrappers, 95 final end mutations, ten focused frame mutations, three recipe-pin mutations, nine owner-certificate mutations, 69 admission mutations, 12 bit-supplier mutations, two exact moment engines and all 47 strict outer constraints. The separate prior PR589 bit-circuit replay is explicitly identified as reused; each new platform run exactly reprices its pinned bit record.

Credits: PR699's BRoute read exchanges and minimal promotion recipe; PR676's p6n construction and per-end controls; PR664's BlockInvert promotion machinery; our PR685/PR660 owner certificate; and all retained gauge, no-triangle, native-audit and bit-supplier lineages. Source commits and original notices are retained in `PROVENANCE.md` and `provenance/`. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

This is a finite conditional witness. All-size compilation, common-label/mutable-source realization, complete-call hosting, precision/tape accounting and analytic transfer remain assumptions. No frame-search or packing optimality, unconditional multiplication theorem, or κ = 1 is claimed.
